events.title: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash at low API prices
events.title_zh: MiniMax 以低价 API 推出 M3.1 Flash
events.summary: MiniMax has launched M3.1 Flash through its API, M Plan and MiniMax Code. Global API pricing is $0.15 per million input tokens, $0.60 per million output tokens and $0.015 per million cached input tokens. MiniMax reports median output above 170 tokens per second and strong agent, coding and computer-use results, but these are vendor-run measurements. Model weights are promised later and are not available at the cutoff.
events.summary_en: MiniMax has launched M3.1 Flash through its API, M Plan and MiniMax Code. Global API pricing is $0.15 per million input tokens, $0.60 per million output tokens and $0.015 per million cached input tokens. MiniMax reports median output above 170 tokens per second and strong agent, coding and computer-use results, but these are vendor-run measurements. Model weights are promised later and are not available at the cutoff.
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 已通过 API、M Plan 和 MiniMax Code 推出 M3.1 Flash。全球 API 每百万 token 价格为输入 0.15 美元、输出 0.60 美元、缓存输入 0.015 美元。MiniMax 称输出速度中位数超过 170 token/s，并公布 agent、coding 与 computer use 成绩，但这些都是厂商评测。权重只承诺稍后发布，截止本轮尚不可下载。
events.why_it_matters: For teams with high-volume coding or agent workloads, the published token prices make M3.1 Flash cheap enough for a one-day routing trial. Measure end-to-end task success and total task cost rather than accepting vendor benchmark or speed claims, and do not plan self-hosting until weights and license terms actually arrive.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams with high-volume coding or agent workloads, the published token prices make M3.1 Flash cheap enough for a one-day routing trial. Measure end-to-end task success and total task cost rather than accepting vendor benchmark or speed claims, and do not plan self-hosting until weights and license terms actually arrive.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对高频 coding 或 agent 任务团队来说，这组 token 价格已经低到值得做一天路由试验。应测端到端任务成功率和整项任务成本，不要直接接受厂商 benchmark 与速度结论；权重和许可真正落地前，也不要按可自托管方案规划。

technical_details.availability: MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code; weights promised later
technical_details.vendor_benchmarks: DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%; OSWorld V2 61.7; CyberGym 82%; evaluation details are vendor-reported
technical_details.time_basis: The visible official page gives 2026-10-19 without a time; midnight metadata is not treated as a verified publication time.

evidence.claim_zh: MiniMax 已开放 M3.1 Flash 的 API、M Plan 与 MiniMax Code，并公布全球 token 价格；权重仍未发布。

events.title: AWS previews TorchNeuron as a native PyTorch backend for Trainium
events.title_zh: AWS 预告面向 Trainium 的原生 PyTorch 后端 TorchNeuron
events.summary: AWS announced TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend intended to run existing PyTorch workloads on Trainium2 and Trainium3 with one configuration change instead of a code rewrite. AWS says Hugging Face tools and TorchTitan already integrate with the backend and cites early users, but the public announcement does not provide independent performance data. Apache-2.0 source is scheduled for October 20 and was not public at the scan cutoff.
events.summary_en: AWS announced TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend intended to run existing PyTorch workloads on Trainium2 and Trainium3 with one configuration change instead of a code rewrite. AWS says Hugging Face tools and TorchTitan already integrate with the backend and cites early users, but the public announcement does not provide independent performance data. Apache-2.0 source is scheduled for October 20 and was not public at the scan cutoff.
events.summary_zh: AWS 宣布 TorchNeuron：一个面向 Trainium2 和 Trainium3 的原生 PyTorch 后端，目标是让现有 PyTorch 任务只改一项配置，不必重写代码。AWS 称 Hugging Face 工具与 TorchTitan 已完成集成，并列出早期用户，但公告没有独立性能数据。Apache-2.0 源码计划在 10 月 20 日开放，截止本轮尚未公开。
events.why_it_matters: For training teams, hardware portability is often limited more by framework rewrites and debugging gaps than by accelerator price. TorchNeuron could lower that switching cost, but teams should wait for the promised repository and test unsupported operators, numerical parity and distributed scaling before committing workloads.
events.why_it_matters_en: For training teams, hardware portability is often limited more by framework rewrites and debugging gaps than by accelerator price. TorchNeuron could lower that switching cost, but teams should wait for the promised repository and test unsupported operators, numerical parity and distributed scaling before committing workloads.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对训练团队来说，硬件迁移的主要门槛往往不是芯片单价，而是框架改写和调试缺口。TorchNeuron 可能降低切换成本，但应等承诺的仓库真正开放，再测试不支持的算子、数值一致性与分布式扩展，之后才考虑迁移任务。

technical_details.license: Apache 2.0 promised, not yet inspectable at cutoff
technical_details.vendor_validation: Amazon says every build is tested against hundreds of thousands of AI models; no independent result published

technical_details_zh.阶段: 已宣布；源码计划于 2026-10-20 开放
technical_details_zh.许可: 承诺 Apache 2.0；截止本轮尚不能检查
technical_details_zh.厂商验证: Amazon 称每个 build 都测试数十万个 AI 模型；未给出独立结果

events.next_action_zh: 等 Apache-2.0 仓库开放后，再用一个现有训练脚本检查算子覆盖、数值一致性和多机扩展。
events.next_action_en: Re-evaluate after the Apache-2.0 repository opens, then test operator coverage, numerical parity and multi-node scaling with one existing training script.

evidence.claim_zh: AWS 宣布 TorchNeuron 将以原生 PyTorch backend 支持 Trainium2/3，并计划于 10 月 20 日以 Apache 2.0 开源。
evidence.claim_en: AWS announced TorchNeuron as a native PyTorch backend for Trainium2/3 and plans to open-source it under Apache 2.0 on October 20.

changes.summary_zh: AWS 预告 TorchNeuron，源码将在截止时间后开放
changes.summary_en: AWS previews TorchNeuron with source scheduled after the cutoff

events.title: DHS discloses an immediate federal civilian exclusion order for DeepSeek
events.title_zh: DHS 公开针对 DeepSeek 的联邦民用系统即时排除令
events.summary: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security publicly filed notice of an exclusion and removal order covering DeepSeek, affiliated entities and third-party products or services developed using DeepSeek implementations in federal civilian agency IT. The signed order is dated July 24, 2026 and required exclusion and removal immediately upon issuance; the Federal Register notice is scheduled for October 20. Agencies may seek written exceptions within 60 days.
events.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security publicly filed notice of an exclusion and removal order covering DeepSeek, affiliated entities and third-party products or services developed using DeepSeek implementations in federal civilian agency IT. The signed order is dated July 24, 2026 and required exclusion and removal immediately upon issuance; the Federal Register notice is scheduled for October 20. Agencies may seek written exceptions within 60 days.
events.summary_zh: 美国国土安全部公开提交了一项排除与移除命令，范围覆盖联邦民用机构 IT 中的 DeepSeek、关联实体，以及使用 DeepSeek 实现开发的第三方产品或服务。签署命令日期为 2026 年 7 月 24 日，并要求签发后立即排除和移除；《联邦公报》通知计划 10 月 20 日刊登。机构可在 60 天内书面申请例外。
events.why_it_matters: For vendors serving U.S. federal civilian agencies, this is broader than blocking the official DeepSeek app: the wording reaches affiliates and third-party products developed using DeepSeek implementations. Procurement and software-supply-chain teams need an inventory and legal interpretation, while non-federal users should not assume the order is a general U.S. ban.
events.why_it_matters_en: For vendors serving U.S. federal civilian agencies, this is broader than blocking the official DeepSeek app: the wording reaches affiliates and third-party products developed using DeepSeek implementations. Procurement and software-supply-chain teams need an inventory and legal interpretation, while non-federal users should not assume the order is a general U.S. ban.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对服务美国联邦民用机构的供应商来说，这不只是禁用 DeepSeek 官方应用：条文还覆盖关联实体，以及使用 DeepSeek 实现开发的第三方产品。采购与软件供应链团队需要先做清单和法律解释；非联邦用户也不要把它误读成美国面向所有主体的全面禁令。

technical_details.effect: immediate upon issuance on July 24, not upon October 20 publication
technical_details.scope: federal civilian executive branch agencies; excludes national-security systems under other authorities
technical_details.exceptions: written requests within 60 days of issuance
technical_details.time_basis: Public Inspection filing says 2026-10-19 8:45 a.m. without an explicit timezone; published_at retains date precision.

technical_details_zh.效力: 2026-07-24 签发后立即生效，不是到 10 月 20 日才生效
technical_details_zh.范围: 联邦民用行政机构；其他权限管辖的国家安全系统不在此范围
technical_details_zh.例外: 签发后 60 天内书面申请
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Public Inspection 文件写明 2026-10-19 8:45 a.m.，但未显式给出时区；published_at 保留日期精度。

events.next_action_zh: 若服务美国联邦民用机构，立即盘点直接或间接使用 DeepSeek 的产品，并让采购与法律团队确认命令适用范围。
events.next_action_en: If you serve U.S. federal civilian agencies, inventory direct and indirect DeepSeek use now and have procurement and legal teams confirm the order’s scope.

evidence.claim_zh: DHS 公布的签署命令要求联邦民用机构自 7 月 24 日签发时起，立即排除并移除 DeepSeek 及相关实现；10 月 19 日是公开披露日。
evidence.claim_en: The signed DHS order requires federal civilian agencies to exclude and remove DeepSeek and covered implementations immediately from its July 24 issuance; October 19 is the public disclosure date.

changes.summary_zh: DHS 首次公开 7 月签发并立即生效的 DeepSeek 排除令
changes.summary_en: DHS publicly discloses the July DeepSeek exclusion order that took effect on issuance

events.title: Inception launches Mercury 3 as a diffusion language model
events.title_zh: Inception 推出扩散语言模型 Mercury 3
events.summary: Inception has launched Mercury 3, a diffusion language model available through its own OpenAI-compatible API, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel. The company offers 100 million free tokens for trials and reports lower latency with stronger evaluation and production results, but does not publish enough independent or same-condition evidence on the launch page to verify those comparisons.
events.summary_en: Inception has launched Mercury 3, a diffusion language model available through its own OpenAI-compatible API, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel. The company offers 100 million free tokens for trials and reports lower latency with stronger evaluation and production results, but does not publish enough independent or same-condition evidence on the launch page to verify those comparisons.
events.summary_zh: Inception 推出扩散语言模型 Mercury 3，可通过自有 OpenAI-compatible API、OpenRouter、Baseten 与 Vercel 调用，并提供 1 亿免费 token 试用。公司称它兼顾更低延迟、评测与生产效果，但发布页缺少足够的独立或同条件证据，无法核实这些比较。
events.why_it_matters: For latency-sensitive agents, diffusion decoding is a materially different serving path and the live API makes a bounded trial possible. Compare end-to-end task success, output length, P95 latency and total cost on the same prompts before changing routing.
events.why_it_matters_en: For latency-sensitive agents, diffusion decoding is a materially different serving path and the live API makes a bounded trial possible. Compare end-to-end task success, output length, P95 latency and total cost on the same prompts before changing routing.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对延迟敏感的 agent 来说，扩散解码是一条不同的 serving 路径，现成 API 足以做有限试验。改路由前要用同一批 prompt 比较任务成功率、输出长度、P95 延迟和总成本。
